title: One-use DIO receipt cannot elevate both required SCHC version and time options
description: Post-fix correctness review: DioTimeVerifier consumes purpose dio-time while LinkLayer SCHC-version admission consumes the same exact RxFrame for dio-schc-version, so a DIO carrying both required options can elevate only one. Paths also disagree on canonical envelope. Implement one atomic canonical DIO elevation that validates once and returns fixed time+version results, or safe fixed fan-out inside one receipt transaction; align envelope/spec/vectors and test both domains from one DIO.
